fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a short cone, dealing 5 damage to everything caught in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Handstand Kick
fusions.desc: A kick from the front hooves that deals 28 damage, ignores resistances and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bad Reputation
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Thick Skin
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You also carry 12% poison resistance.
